story.title: The Art of the Pipe-Cleaner Bloom
story.p1: Every bloom at Sangita Handmade begins as humble chenille wire stems. With patient hands and creative mastery, artisan Sangita bends, twists, and shapes each delicate petal into realistic, everlasting flowers.
story.p2: Unlike fresh flowers that fade in days or mass-produced plastic flowers, our artisanal blooms offer timeless beauty, vibrant colors, and personal sentimental value. Made to cherish forever.
story.bullet1: Zero maintenance — never wilts, fades, or requires water
story.bullet2: Flexible stems — perfect for custom vases and gift arrangements
story.bullet3: Each piece is an original, sculpted work of personal art
